mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pharmacy_in_order (order_no, supplier_id, in_date, warehouse_id, total_amount, status, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{supplierId}, #{inDate}, #{warehouseId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, supplier_id, in_date, warehouse_id, total_amount, status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM pharmacy_in_order WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, order_no, supplier_id, in_date, warehouse_id, total_amount, status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM pharmacy_in_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT id, order_no, supplier_id, in_date, warehouse_id, total_amount, status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM pharmacy_in_order ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
